Sana: FYI overnight we had a partial onboarding import failure; ~10 tenants affected, 3 in imminent renewal windows. Need quick customer notes + renewal mitigation.

incident-bot: Incident onboarding-imports: detected 2026-04-02T00:40Z, mitigated 2026-04-02T02:25Z.

Liam: Which three are renewal-risk?

Sana: List in DM sheet: PaperCo (acct_paper), Meridian Labs (acct_merid), BrightPath (acct_bpath). Failures mostly 00:30-00:50 UTC.

Priya: Suggested mitigation for the three: 15% credit on next invoice, two enablement hours, priority manual re-ingest + a private office hour. I recommend sending those within 2 hours.

Gina: SE will run manual retries. Quick command: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/imports/retry -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"acct_paper"}'```

Liam: Root cause: transient S3 latency triggered queue circuit-breaker during nightly GC. We replayed messages, extended S3 timeouts. No data lost. RCA being drafted.

Sana: Draft outbound for high-risk tenants: short apology, note the resolved retry, list the mitigation (15% credit, 2h enablement, manual re-run), and invite to private office hour. Priya will send; mark renewal owners and tag in Gainsight.

Priya: Ill send personalized emails now and batch the rest for 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Ill capture feedback in tracker and schedule NPS follow-up in 7 days.

Gina: SE standing by for manual retries during office hour.

Sana: Closing thread  please update the shared tracker when outreach sent. (reactions: :thumbsup:)
